entities.summary: Ewo is a village and a commune located in the Republic of the Congo that serves as the administrative center of Ewo District and the Cuvette-Ouest department. Situated on the banks of the Kouyou River, Ewo had a population of 28,229 inhabitants in 2023, the date of the country's last official census. It is served by Ewo Airport.
